description: This file defines the ManufacturerEntity class, which extends Manufacturer and adds an 'order' property with getter and setter methods. It is part of the package responsible for catalog manufacturer entities within the web layer.

classes.name: ManufacturerEntity
classes.description: A class representing a manufacturer entity, extending the base Manufacturer class and adding an 'order' field.
